# Primegate Consultancy

> Dubai-based international education advisory and management consulting firm. Primegate connects the world's leading universities with high-intent students across the Middle East, South Asia, Southeast Asia, CIS and Africa; guides students studying abroad or within the Gulf; supports education agents; and helps entrepreneurs and companies establish and grow in the UAE. Founded 2025, built on 30 years of personal, founder-led expertise. Based at Meydan, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

## What Primegate does (four advisory areas)
- [For Universities](https://primegateconsultancy.com/university-partnership): Primegate acts as a trusted, exclusive international recruitment partner for universities - carrying the marketing and recruitment across the Middle East, South Asia, Southeast Asia, CIS and Africa, and delivering verified, high-intent, compliance-vetted students to the international office.
- [Study Abroad](https://primegateconsultancy.com/study-abroad): Personal, founder-led guidance for students leaving the Middle East to study in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe and Asia-Pacific - shortlisting, applications, scholarships, offers and visas.
- [Study in the Middle East](https://primegateconsultancy.com/study-in-middle-east): Advisory for international students choosing the Gulf - NYU Abu Dhabi, Sorbonne, Heriot-Watt, Georgetown Qatar and 60+ accredited institutions in a tax-free, multicultural region.
- [Management Consulting](https://primegateconsultancy.com/management-consulting): Business setup and company formation in the UAE - mainland and free zone formation (IFZA, Meydan, DMCC, RAKEZ), trade licensing, PRO and government services, investor and employment visas, corporate and private banking introductions, management training, and web development and digital marketing.

## Other pages

## Institutions Primegate Consultancy represents
- [Higher Education directory](https://primegateconsultancy.com/higher-education): All higher-education institutions in one directory, grouped by destination (Europe, Middle East, United Kingdom, Canada) with each institution's relationship: Exclusive Representative Office, Admissions Partner, or available through the ApplyBoard partnership.
- [IDEA College, Malta](https://primegateconsultancy.com/idea-college-malta): Primegate Consultancy is the Exclusive Representative Office. MFHEA-accredited (Licence 2014-FHI-015), EU-recognised MQF 4-8 qualifications, foundation to doctorate; full programme list by MQF level.
- [IDEA Academy, UAE](https://primegateconsultancy.com/idea-academy-uae): Primegate Consultancy is the Exclusive Representative Office. KHDA-licensed academy in Dubai (Licence 630698) offering EQF-aligned certificates and diplomas (EQF 4-5).
- [Fondazione Doria - Training and Education Institute](https://primegateconsultancy.com/fondazione-doria): Primegate Consultancy is the Exclusive Representative Office. Italian training institute in Campania accredited by the Campania Region: regional healthcare qualifications (OSS/OSA), a culinary academy and online university pathways with eCampus University.
- Admissions Partner for Ajman University (UAE), Alpine Swiss Business School (Switzerland) and the American University in the Emirates (UAE); programme lists on request.
- [K-12 and schools](https://primegateconsultancy.com/k12-learning): The schools Primegate represents for K-12 and boarding education, starting with Eastwood Montreux in Switzerland.
- [Eastwood Montreux International School](https://primegateconsultancy.com/eastwood-montreux): Primegate is the Official Marketing & Admissions Partner for Eastwood Montreux, a Swiss day and boarding school on Lake Geneva.

## Blog
- [Study abroad blog](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog): Study-abroad guides on Italy, Malta and Dubai - vocational courses, visas, jobs, language, costs and in-demand careers.

## Guides: studying in Malta and Dubai
- [MQF levels explained](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-mqf-levels-explained): Malta Qualifications Framework Levels 1-8 with official examples, typical ECTS and EQF levels; MQF vs UK and South African NQF levels; how to get an MQF recognition statement from MQRIC.
- [Study abroad: Malta vs Dubai](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-study-malta-vs-dubai): A comparison of cost, language, recognition, work rights and lifestyle for Gulf and South Asian students.
- [Why Malta is a top study destination in 2026](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-why-study-in-malta): Why international students choose Malta and who the destination suits best.
- [The most in-demand fields to study in 2026](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-in-demand-fields-2026): Healthcare, AI, fintech and early childhood education, and what to study to enter them.

## Guides: studying and working in Italy (Fondazione Doria)
- [Study in Italy: vocational courses with internships](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-study-in-italy-vocational-courses): 127 English-taught vocational programmes at Fondazione Doria, each leading into a professional internship of approximately three months; fees EUR 9,500-13,500; monthly intakes; living costs in Angri.
- [Jobs in Italy for international students](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-jobs-in-italy-international-students): In-demand careers in care, hospitality, skilled trades and IT, with official hiring data, and how training with an internship leads to work.
- [Italy student visa for vocational courses](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-italy-student-visa-vocational-courses): Type D study visa requirements, documents checklist, proof of funds, timeline and common refusal reasons.
- [Learning Italian for study and work](https://primegateconsultancy.com/blog-learning-italian-beginners-guide): What A1, A2 and B1 mean, how to start before you travel, and when CELI or CILS certificates matter.
